name: CG Animated Feature: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the CG Animated Feature look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing simplified proportions, large expressive eyes, sculpted hair shapes, soft subsurface skin, tactile cloth and fur, cinematic three-point lighting, warm key and cool fill, soft global illumination, shallow depth of field
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, uncanny, flat 2d, low-poly, harsh shadows, extra fingers, text, watermark
